title: GraphSmith attestation recall / revocation (R3)
description: A record that recalls a previously published attestation bundle (e.g. a signer was later revoked, or a defect was found). A verifier given the recall list flags a recalled bundle on re-verify — fail-closed: a recalled bundle never re-verifies as valid. C1: `recalled_at` is evidence, never a decision input. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.4.0).

manifest_sha256.description: Binds the recall to the exact bundle content.

recalled_at.description: Evidence only (C1); never a decision input.
